title: docs: fix three broken links
body:
- optimize-revalidation.md linked `fetcher.submit` to a non-existent `fetcher-submit` page and, on the next bullet, to an undefined shortcut reference. Both now use the file's existing [use-fetcher] definition.
- middleware.md used the [getloadcontext] reference without defining it; added a definition pointing at the page's own getLoadContext section.
- api-development-strategy.md linked to ../start/changelog, which does not exist. Now points at the CHANGELOG on GitHub, matching how other docs link to it.
